sngon gleng /ra༅༅/ /rang cag bod kyi 7rgyal khab tu sngar bskal bzang lugs bzang gi dus skabs su rgyal sa lha sar gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i chos srid lugs gonyes kyi dbu 'khrid mtho shos spyi nor 7gong sa 7rgyal ba'i dbang po 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog dbu bzhugs kyis 'char can gzhung 'brel mdzad chen khag dang / de bzhin yul lung gi sngar srol spro skyid gtong ba'i dus chen ji yod rnams deng skabs kyi rang rigs galha na nu rnams nas mkhyen sna gas ched/ da lta nas yig lam chodag gsal 'god thub pa dgos gal che nges yin par dgongs bzhes bla med kyis/ dha sa bzhugs sgar bod phrug khyim sde'i dbu 'dzin 7sku'i gcung mo lha lcam rje btsun padma mchog nas/ de snga'i gzhung zhabs bgres gras sku zhabs shag byang zur pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan lags su 'bri ce ma gnang bcug pa'i ma zin de dag 'di ga bod kyi dpe mdzod khang du stsal te/da dung zhu dag zhib tshags dang 'brel par 'debs zhu dbo sa bka' mngags phebagopa bzhin/ dpe mchodad dbu 'dzin nas gus pa gzhung zhabs rnying pa rgas sku/la thub bstan sangs rgyas bdag la bskyar zhib zhu dbenas gsung pa ltar/ rang nyid nas gang shes zhabs 'gyur ma zhus tshad bral ltar bskyar batho sa phran bu zhu 'os rigs zhus khul thog rdo bum sprul sku rin dze che nas zhib brtags mdzad pa bcas lags kyang / da mtshams 61 rgyun nyung min

'das zin pas blo brjed gyur pa dang / 'ga' zhig rang la'ang rgyus mnga' zhib cha yod med sna tshogs kyis da dung nor 'khrul dang / 'tshems lus 'ga' re yong rgyu gzhir bcas thog rgyus mnga' mchis pa dag kyang ha cang zhib phra 'god rgyur yig rdzob che chags dang / par 'don dus 'gyangs 'gro gzhir bsams snga 'phros 'di tsam la cha bzhag ste/ sngar srol bzangapo'i lo rgyus ma 'ongs pa'i blo ldan rnams kyi dran yul du gting brjed rtsa brlags mi 'byung tsam gyi ched bod kyi rig gzhung gi cha shas sa bkod /pa/rwardo/da tsho rang

(spar skrun thengs gnyis pa'i gsal bshad)rī༄༄/ deng rabs kyi shes yon gyi 'khor yug nang 'tshar longs byas pa'i gzhis byes gnyis kyi na ga3/na rnams la/ gna' 19la gyi bo/mas 19la bzang po dang / lo rgyus kyi legs skyes 'bul rgyu mi rabs rgan pa dang /lhag par bod kyi rig gzhung slob gnyer khang dpe mdzod lta bur skabs su babs pa'i 'gan lci mo zhig yin pa 10sa ga la dbo sa/ co(na kyang phyi 'o/ 1959 sngon gyi bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen wa'i sri zhu ba phal mo che zhig sku zhi bar gshegs zin pas/ dathogs su sku 'aco bzhugs gnang ba'i zhal nas nyams ca/nga gi gnas tshul gsan pa'i ben skabs phra ba'i dus 'dir/ (bod kyi dus ston ) zhes pa'i phyag deb 'di deng rabs kyi na gzhon dag gi rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'gyur bar nges/ 'on kyang bod rgya khyab po ngas kyi dus rjodan thams cad deb chung gcig tu btu bas mi langs kyang /'di'i nang bod mtha' dbus kun gyis mig ltos bya yul bod gzhung 'brel gyi dus ྅ na gal sngo che rnams 'du ba'i khul byas thengs dang sngo 1974lor spar du bskrun 'dug mod/ de nas bzung da bar dus yun ring tsam phyin pas phyag deb de nyid rdzogs te rgya che'i klog pa po mang po'i dgos mkho sgrub mi thub pas thengs gnyis pa spar skrun zhu gi mo da/ nyo ga ma phyag deb 'di nyid bod phrug khyim sde'i dbu 'dzin da lta 'tsho bzhugs bka' zur sku'i gcung mo lha lcam rje btsun padma mchog gis bskul ma gnang ba ltar/ gzhung

zhabs bgres pa sku gshegs shag byang zur pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bsgrigs pa dang / skabs de'i bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi spyi khyab 'gan 'dzin da lta 'tsho bzhugs sku ngo rgya mtsho tshe ring mchog gis thugs 'khur bzhes pa'i 'og dpe myo/dzod khang gi nyams zhib pa gzhis byes gnyis kyi gzhung zhabs bgres sku/la cesas lha/na drung zur gnas gsar mkhan chung sku gshegs thub bstan sangs rgyas dang / da lta'i ldi li'i bod khang gi dbu 'dzin sna bum mchog sprul rin sngo tre rnam gnyis nas bskyar zhib dang zhu dag gnang ba yin 'dug pas khungs btsun par ma zad/ da lta'i spar skrun gnyis pa'i sngon du yang bskyar gzhung zhabs bgrel yol dpal 'byor drung zur da lta 'tsho bzhugs phya nang dge slong blo bzang don ldan mchog la/ da dung 'tshems lus sku/da tshe kha do/nga gi bskul ma zhus pas/ gzhung zhabs bgres yol bde sung drung zur dom po rtsemagron sku ngo ngag dbang rigs grol mchog sku ma gshegs gong tsam la khong dang mol bsdur mdzad de/ gnas chungachos rgyal chen po'i mdzad rim sa ra sku gas bskyar 'jug gnang bas cha lag je tshang du song ba bcas mdor na/ snga rjes su phyag deb 'di nyid la thugs 'khur bzhes pa'i mi sna da lta 'tsho bzhugs yod med kun gyi bkrin la dpe mjo da khang gis gus bkur zhu ba dang chabs cig phyi 'o/ 1959 ༄ na gyi lha/da gzhung 'brel gyi mdzad rim gal che khag gsal ba'i/ ྅/da kyi dus ston ces pa'i deb chung 'di nyid bod gzhung dpe mdzod khang gis slar yang rang rigs gcadan nu sdu gsal can rnams kyi babo skal du spar bskrun zhus pa'i rnam dkar gyi dge bas/ snu sa srid gnyis ldan gyi rgyal khab chen wa'i

dbu khrid 7bo/nga sa 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing / thugs kyi bzhed dbo ngas ma lus lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sgyu na lam bzang yodas mtshams sbyar te (bod kyi dus ston) zhes pa'i phyag deb spar skrun thengs gnyis pa'i ngo sprod du dpe mdzod khang gi spyi khyab 'gan 'dzin dga' ldan shar rtse'i sku ga pa mkhan zur a mchog sprul skus 1999 phyi zla 11 ches 27 la ༷bros/

dgung gsar dgyes ston nyin dang po/rozher༅༅/ /gnam lo gsar tshes kyi nyin dang po bla ma lo gsar/ lo re'i bod zla 1 tshes 1 dgung gsar dgyes ston nyin dang por snga dro chu tshod gnyis pa'i thog rtsepho brang dbu rtsenas gar rol pas bzhengs brda phul bstun bod ljongs stod bcud chos srid yongs kyi don gyi bdag po spyi nor 7tho nga sa 7skyabs mthon chen 10 sku bzhengs kyis rgyun gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes grub pa dang / rtsegasku la thab nas bkris bde legs kyi cad so phye mar dang gsol ja/ bzhes 'bras/ bo thug de bzhin bar thab nas kyang gro so phye mar dang / chang phud bzhed ldan sogs rim phebs dang bstun nang ma snang gi mdzad sbru/ grub 'phral mtshan gzim khang du chibs bsgyur gyis bde stan thog zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / sku'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang /mtshan zhabs/ rnam grwa gsung zhabs bcas nas mjal dar phul te phyag dbang stsal/ gral 'kho da kyis gasdu/la bo/ bzhes 'bras sku/gas rim phebs zhal 'don grub pa dang / nyi 'od du bzhugs khri rin po cher zhabs sor 'kho da mtshams srid bkas mcho na pa'i nang ma mkhan sde che chung yan nas bkris bde legs kyi mjal dar re phul/ phyag dbang stsal te gral la 'khod/

2gro so phye mar/ gsol ja/ bzhes 'bras sogs phebs/ de nas pho brang dbu rtser phebs skabs bka' blon khri pa dang / sku bcar spyi mkhan nas phyag 'dren zhus/ bkris rtags brgyad ri snu/sa phyug pa'i ras dkar gyi 'engs ras bting ste gar mkhan nas phebs brda bsu sna/ spyan rgya sgos 'dzin sku gas kyis sngan bsus te gdan zhus kyis 7tho nga sa macodag bzhugs khrir zhabs sku ra drokhe/da/ bka' sdu na bgres pa nas gzhung gnas kyi rten gsum mjal dar btegs 'bul dang 'brel srid bkas mtshon yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis dbus rtsezhod las tshan nas go bab kyi mjal dar dkar gtsang re phul/ mu mthud gsung zhabs rnam grwa nas phyag dbang zhus te gral la 'khod/ zhal 'don dbu tshugs/ rnam grwa dbu mdzad kyi brda dang bstun gasku la ja/ bzhes 'bras sku gas rim bzhin phebs/ 'asnga da khams bdag mo dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i gtang rag tshes gtor gyi gtor 'bul gsol chogs legs par grub rjes rtsemakhan mgron che bas 7gong sa chen por gus btud phyed gzan phab ste dkar spro bkye chog zhus/ ka khri sgrogs te tshes gtor gyi mdzad sgo'i rim pa grub rjes phebs ras/ spyan spos sogs gong bzhin gyis gzim chung du gdan zhus zhu/ gzhung zhabs ser mo ba rnams na bza' phya gru phya stod brje bzhes kyis drung ja tshugs/ bkris bde legs kyi phye mar dang gsol ja dang po dang / gro ma 'bras sil bzhes thug gsol tshigs sogs rim bzhin phebs/ rtsosmor las tshan yan gzim chung nyi 'od du bcar/ mdo sbug tshang mar gsol tshigs gzab rgyas stsal/

3gsol ja gnyis pa phebs/ rtse stor rnams na bza' phya gru phya stod bzhes/7gong sa chen por gong bzhin phyag 'dren dang / spyan sgos phebs ras sogs sngar bzhin zhus te tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su gdan zhus kyis gser khri chen mor zhabs so/ra 'khod/ 'bras se dga' gsum gyi rgyal sprul ho thog thu khag dang / slob dpon/ bla sprul las sne bcas nas phyag 'tshal dang 'brel mkhan re bgres pa nas bla spyi'i rten gsum btegs 'bul gyis ma/jal kha zhus/ phyag dbang stsal/ gral la 'khe/da/ 7lha nga sa chen gro'i sku mdun rtse mkhan mabo na chen snu sa phyed gzan phab pa'i gus btud zhus te mabo na brgyud kyis 7gong sa mchog nas tho khu1ga thu khag dang /'bras se dga' gsum gyi slob dpon las sne 'dus mang dang bcas pa khams bzang dze byung ngam zhes bka'i 'tshams 'dri bskyangs/ blo na lam dge bshes mtshan rtags 'jo ga mi'i kho ngas nas babo gleng pa (tshogs langs pa ) lha rams pa cha gnyis re skrunags rangs sna da pa tshugs/ gral 'phros pa zhes rtsesgor dkyus ma gnyis de nyin las tshan pa'i gdan thob stag gdan re zur du bting yod pa'i thog bkris pa/'i tshegs bcad dbyangs su sgro gas bzhin 'khod/ gsol ja phebs/ rtse mkhan mgron che ba'i bde dang bstun gar phragal ba rnams nas gar dang sngo 'khyab/ bzhes 'bras phebs/mjal thengs gnyis pa stsal/ gar gnyis pa 'khrab/ bzhes thug bo/ thug dang gsol tshigs phebs/ zhabs pad gonyes sku bzhengs kyis dkar khra'i g.yas ga yon du phebs/ te gzigs zhib dang 'brel 〉shod phyag mdzod dang /

4lca zhol gnyer tshang / rtsam len do dam sogs nas dkar lngeb drag so bcis tsam bsgrigs 'bul thog mgron che mas gus btud kyis dkar spro bkye chos zhus 'phral 7gong sa chen por gsol dpon sku bgres nas dalar spro'i phud nas gasku/la bskangs phul rjes mdzad zhabs rnams la celamabo na nas ga'o/la bskangs shing 'bras 'grems spel zhus/ mi mang nas/ dkar spror sdebs macodang rgyag gar gsum pa 'khrab/ salha/la ja gsum pa phebs/ babo gleng pa (tshogs langs pa ) nas bkris tshig bkra bcad de ma jal wa zhu/ phyag srung dang / 'phral bde las khungs kyi 1/nga sasal gasku/gas dar stsal/ thugs rje che zhu'i phyag 'tshal zhu/ ka khri sgrogs de phebs ras / phyag 'dren/ spyan spos sku gas bo nga bzhin zhus rtse gzim chung du gdan zhu zhas te dgung gsar nyin dang po' mdzad sgo grol/ 'di'i nyin dang por blab ma/ lo gsar zhes 'bod srol yod/ gang lags rsha na/ de nyin bod kyi bla chen rnams dang sadam gsum sku/gas dbonan khag bi mkhan sngo tshang mas 7bong sa chen por bkris bde legs zhu bcar dbang bis de ltar 'bod ru/la chags pa red

dgung gsar dgyes ston nyin gnyis pa/——go༅༅/ /gnam lo gsar tshes kyi nyin gnyis pri rgyal po lo gsar/ bod zla 1 tshes 2 dgung gsar dgyes sdon nyin gnyis par snga dro'i chu tshod 9 thos rtsegazim chung nyi 'od du drung bzhes dang gsol tshigs phebs/de nas gar rol ba'i phebs brda dang bstun phebs ras/ spyan rgya so/gas snga nyin lngar thog 7song sa chen wa'i phyag 'dren sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po dang rin chen rgyan cha ba khri pa nas zhus te 〉rgams chen srid zhi'i phun cho gas su gdan zhu zhus/ gser khri chen mor zhabs sor 'kho da 'phral rin chen rgyan cha ba rnams dang / rnam grwa dbu sdu/ba gsung 'bas bcas nas bzhugs khri'i spyan sngar 'greng bzhengs kyi thog nas zhal 'don rol cha dang bcas rten 'byung gi sarga gtod phyir bkris rtags brgyad dang / rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun sku/gas rim bzhin tshig mtshams spo snu ra rin rgyan khri pas bshegs 'bul zhus te grub mtshams tshang mas sku phyag phul tshe bka' sdu na bgres pa nas gzhung gnas kyi shen gsum batshegs 'bul dang 'brel srid bkas masnu na sku ngas 'dzin rnam gces dang yab gzhis sku 1ri rnam pa/ dza ngar ta tha'i nang ma mkhan sde che chung phogs mda'/ rtsis srag/ rtse

6shod las tshan khongs gtogs tshang ma dang / rtse rig gnas slob dge/ lha sdod phyi rgyal sku tshab khag bcas dang / kha bal/ la 'brug mi sna so so nas bo bab kyis mjal dar dkar gtsang re phul te mjal kha zhus nas rang rang gi go thob ltar gyi gral gdan la 'khod/ rtse mkhan mgron chen mos phyed gzan phab sne gus btud la 7gong sa mchog nas gung bka' blon/mi drag rnams dang / phyi rgyal sku tshab sogs la mgron brgyud kyis bka'i 'tshams 'dri bskyangs/ rin rgyan mgron ches gsol ja gdan zhus kyis rin rgyan gsol che nas sku bcar gsol che'i phyag brgyud gsol ja/ bzhes 'bras btegs pa dang chabs cig mdzad zhabs tshang mar galha/la ja bzhes 'bras phebs/ zlos gar ba gzhon nu rnams nas gar dang po 'khrab/ bgro gling pa (tshogs langs pa ) gnyis nas rtsod pa dang / gral 'a'o/sa pa gnyis nas bkris tshig bkra bcas tshugs/ mjal thengs gnyis par/ sa skya ba dang / bkras lhun bla brang / rdor smin/ 'bri 'brug mtshur stag sogs nas dgung gsar rten 'byung 'bul mjal dang / rtse shod zhabs gsar ba gsar mjal khag bcas nas rten gsum btegs 'bul zhus te rang rang gdan thob la 'khod/ bzhes thug phebs/ nye 'khor gzhis khag 'bras bu gling bi kho ngas nas/ 7song sa lnga po'i sazigs snang du byung ba lha dang / tshangs ri / brgya byin/ dri za / gru ra bum la sogs pa'i mchod gar rnga rol glu dbyangs dang bcas rim bzhin bstar bsgrigos kyis gzigs 'bul zhus/ bzhes 'bras phebs/ gar thengs gnyis par swā sa gar ba skyes pa rme bzhi nas lag sanyis nar spi ring re thogs te gri gar

7'khrab/ rin rgyan khri pa dang / bka' blon phebs res nas dkar spro bsgrigs 'bul gzigs zhib bskyangs/ ga1/la tshigs phebs/ 'di skabs gar rol pas gling bu snyan 'jebs shig gtong / bka' blon rnam pa dang / sku bcar spyi mkhan/ dza tha'i so gas kyi gsol tshigs rang khungs so so'i shag nas mgron g.yog gis bsnams pa rgya lcog chung chung re'i steng bsgrigs te mchod/ mabo na ches gus btud (gus 'dud ) bkye chog zhus pa dang / 7gong sa chen por gsol che nas gsol bskangs phul rjes mdzad zhabs sku mgron khag la rtsomagron nas gsol bskangs shing 'bras 'grems 'bul zhus 'phral ci/mang nas dkar spror sdebs mchong rgyag gsol ja gaphyis pa phebs/ slar yang sdu sa gar ba ga3/na nu rnams nas glu gar mi 'dra ba zhig gi gar thengs gsum pa 'khrab/ bshod 1nga (tshogs langs ) phebs res gnyis nas bkris pa'i tshig bkra bcad de phyag 'tshal dang 'brel mjal dar rang 14ga 11ga phyag dbang dang phyag srung stsal/ 'phral bde las khungs kyis sku/nga gsal gasku/gas dar/ gnang cha stsal bar thugs rje che zhu'i phyag 'tshal zhu/ ka khri sgrogs te grol ba dang bstun ldo ring nang ma'i rdo gcal steng gtsang lung nag shel dkar ba nas gnam thothag rtsed ces pa'i shing rtsed sar gzhol mi mang rnams zhal mjal dang chabs cig ltad mor ji snyed yong srol/ lo gsar nyin gnyis pa la spyir btang rgyal po lo gsar zer zhing / de ni 7gong sa chen pos rgyal srid dang / chos srid gnyis ma'i bdag dbang zung 'brel du bzhes pa'i khongs nas sngar gyi rgyal srid kyi lugs khrol dang mthun pa'idagung gsar gyi mdzad sgo yin pa'i dbang gis de ltar brjod srol chags 'dug

dgung gsar dgyes ston nyin gsum pa/——༄༅/ /bod zla tshes 3nyin rtse pho brang du snga dro'i drung bzhes 'char can rtse skor khe gtsang las/ shod skor med pa'i thog 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang /yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sogs dbu bzhugs kyis rnam grwa co gas sku ngas nas 'asnga da khams bdag sna/ gathe gyur gyi srung spyi'i gzab gasku la rgyas pa bskyang /sa/sku/la tshigs phebs/gzim chung lha mo'i spyan sngar 7gong sa 7skyabs mabon chen po mchog dang /rgyal bstan chab srid/skye 'gro'i bde skyid bcas kyi skor la zan brtag bsgril 'bul bskyangs pas 'di la tshes gsum zan bsgril zhes grags/de nyin dga' ldan dar chen sku bzhings grub 'phral mi dngo/na gnyis nas 'gag tu 7snyan gsang mjal bcar zhu/'bras co gas chen zhal cig nga las 'asdu ra mjal zhus 'brel lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i ring blang dor byed sgo'i sgor la rtse gzim 'gag nas maskra/na ches bka' bsgyur stsal/nang ma yan la dkar spro rgyas pa phebs te drung bzhes grol/de nyin bka' blon rnam pa dang /phogs mda' rtsis phyagalha zhol gnyer mi dpon gyis mtshon shod sgor gzhung zhabs rnams snga char gnas chung ྅ rjo sgra dbyangs gling du dgung gsar gyi

9rten 'byang lha tshes gzab gsol du phebs dgos thog rtse nas sku tshab sku bcar zlokhan che gcig dang / 7sbag da ma lung zhu sgron dar bcas phebs/de 'brel gzhung sa mchog nas lha rshab mdzad pa'i lha khog brlams/ chog pa rnams kyi lha khral rdzong khag so sos bsdu len bgyis te bsher dpang brgyud sanas chung chos rgyal chen por 7snyan sgron dang 'brel 'bul lam zhus thog nas mchodag gsum rgya mtshor de nyin rdo nga mchodad gzab rgyas shig 'bul datho sa pa dang / gzab gsol grub 'phral bsher dpang dang / bkras lhun nang ma sgang / sa skya/ mtsho sna rdzong bcas nas gzhung deb nang gsal bzhin chos rgyal chen por mthun rdzas sgron dar dang / ljon ja/ gos yod kyi dgu tshan/ gser chod gsum/ dngul gyi zhal dkar/ gnas chung dpe tar lcog gi rgyal mtshan/ dar chen gyi na bza' bcas sgron 'bul gnang dgos/ lda tshes grub 'phral rdzong rgyab spro khang du tshang ma phebang te gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang gasku/la tshigs/ dkar khyod/ mchodad chang / gar pa nas bloril cha glu gar/ rgyang ma'i mda' rtsed bcas grub rjes bla phyag nas legs dar phul te grol/ de nas lda ldan du 'bras tshogs chen chab dam pa nas ding khung chu mig sku/gas sa 'das khag la sgrig lha'i co gas gtam btang / dgong dro yar tshogs gral shādzin/ khyams ra'i dbu g.yab nang bka' shag skrunags gzigs la phebs/ co gas chen zhal 1ri nas bca' yig chen mo sgrogs sbyang dang 'brel smon lam ring byed sgo'i dril bsgrags/de nyin bla phyag nas gsol ja mang ja dang / dge 'dun rer bkris pa'i 'dzugs dar re sgron te grol/

0lha lda na smon lam chen mo/——༄༅༅/ /bod zla 1 tshes 4 nyin nas lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i gsol tshogs dngos gzhi dbu tshugs rgyur/ chos sde chen mo 'bras se dga' gsum dang / dbon sde sgrigs nyis 'dzin khag gi dge 'dun rnams 'khyams ra dang / bar smor phyi nang / se ra ltag sgo/ mda' g.yab 'og shing ra bcas la bsdoms dge 'dun nyis khri brgal ba dang / gsung chos ra ba'i mdor dge 'dun dang dbon ser gzugs khyon grangs nyis stong skor yod/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po smon lam tshogs mgon du chibs bsgrar che mo yod skabs khrom gzigs khang gi rgyab thang du gnas chung chos rgyarmo chen po 'tshams zhu'i rma jal dar du phebs srol yod/ smon lam zhag21 tshugs ring zhin rer gsol ja bdun dang / bzhes thug gnyis re bcas bstan pa maskrubad sbyin gyi mnga' bdag gzhung gnas nas thugs 'gan gtsang bzhes thog 7rgyal mchog 7gong ma rim byon gyi dgongs rdzogs ched sku 'gyed dang / de bzhin rtse gzim chung nas spyan bsal sku 'gyed bcas bstar chags dang / gzhan yang li thang55 'brug tshang nas 11ga macirngo thebs sbyar gyis sgo 'phar dbye bas mcho na dad ldan 'das gasku na khag gi ched du

13yang zhabs stegs thog 'kho da/ mjal kha'i 'phro stsal tshogs 'kho ra bkye 'grems zhus/ chos skyong sku sangs/ gzab gso la mdzad sgo grub 'phral 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchos chibs 'bas dang bcas bla rtseng gzim chung du chibs bsgyur bskyangs/

4cod 'phrul dus chen dasngo sa gzhi/——ra༅༅/ /bod zla 1 tshes 15 nyin/ sngon 'phags yul mnyan yod du ston pa thugs rje can gyis mu stegs khyon pa drug cho 'phrul gyis tshar bcad pa'i dus chen dngos gzhi'i nyi mar brten zhogs tshogs snga char grol te/khyams ra chen mor 7gong sa 7skyabs mabon chen po mchog bzhugs khrir zhabs bkod bkrin che ste gso spyong bskyangs/ de nas gsung rar chibs bsgrar gyis gdan gsum mkhan sngo bla sprul dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya/dge 'dun tshogs yongs bcas la zab rgyas codas kyi 'khor lo stsal skabs rme zhing phyog nas gnas chung chos rgyal chen po bsten gzhir spyan 'dren mdzad de/ nub ma'i khang pa brgyud bar sgor lto rgyud nas gsung rar phebs/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mabo/na chen sngo mace)ga gi sku mdun du chodas rgyal chen sngo sa gus 'dud pad 'bul rten 'gyogs mdzad nas phyir phebs lam zhor rung khang chen snu/ra rab gnas mdzad/ skabs 'gar lho bur gnas gzigs su phebs nas rme rnying du phyir phebs pa dang / 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur med par dga' ldan khri rin po ce gsung rar phebs skabs kyang snu sa skyong gi mdzad rim de ltar thog gsung rar rtse'i sku tshab nas thugs smon sgron dar

bcas gnang lam yod rdo nas dgung tshigs grol rjes 'khyams rar gdabye gnyer nas bzhags khi son rgyas thos 7gong sa mchog chibs bslar bis ni spyo shā /sdu// bsdeX rdo ཿdzābazhugs zhabs 'khod/ rgyal sprul sogs sprul sle che 'bring yongs rdzogs dang / mkhan bla/ gzhung zhabazlo ser skya/ 'brashā tshogs chen dbu mdzad dang / grwa tshang bzhi'i chos dbyangs dbu mdzin/ gdam gsum tshogasachen dbu mdzad dang grwa tshang khag gi dbu mdzad/ 'dus mang bcas bcar she tsham tshogs smon lam chen mo'i mchod 'bul dang 'al 'don bcas rgyas par mdzad gnang / 7gong sa mchog gis ljags bsdo bde smon dang bstan 'bar ma bcas rgyas par bkrin bskyangs grub rjes smon lam shis brjod bcas gsungs te grol/ 7gong sa mchog tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyar med tshe dga' ldan khri rin po che nas tshogs mabon mdzad/ ༄nge nas dargong ja tshogs dgongs ja grol mtshams gdan gsum gyi lda rams dge ba'es dam bca' ba res mo su yin nas dam bca' 'jog gnang mdzad/ dam bca'i bgro gling grub rjes bco lnga mchod pa'i mchod gzigs su chibs bsgyur bcas yin/

8phyir gzhas kyi 'gran bsdur yang byed srol yong / yar ngo'i tshes cha gang 'os la spyan bsal sku 'gyed ces rtse gzim chung nas dmigs bsal gyi gsol ja dang / bzhes thug 'bras tsha/ sku 'gyed ṭam dkar re bcas 'char can stsal ba red/

9bla ma dga' ston/——ra༅༅//bod zla tshes 6 7 gang rung zhig gi nyin bla ma dga' ston zhes lha ldan bla steng tshoms chen khams gsum nang du bka' shag gdan gnyer nas bzhugs khri bzhugs gdan tā/na rgyag gis bka' drung nas sngon tshud snyan brda dang 'brel dga' ldan khri rin po che dbu bzhugs thog gdan gsum gyi mkhan po tshang ma dang /smon lam cho gas chen dbu mdzad/tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis/pho brang sde pa dang spyi so sogs gdan gsum las sme che khag rnams la bka' shag nas gzhung gnas kyi sngar lha/la ga1/la don thengs gcig 'bul gnang skabs la thog mar gsol ja/bzhes 'bras/bzhes thugabagathud/ mar zan/ gsol dkrum skam btsos sder bkang /dkar sgro kha zas/shing 'bras sogs dang /khri rin po cher snen gsum mjal dar dang /byings la legs dar re bcas/ 'bul gnang mjad dgos/

20dpal lha'i gzab gasdu/la/shezhe༄༅༅//bod zla tshes 920dgang rung zhig gi nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi yang rtseng dpal lha ltog tu dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang mo zhi drag la gzhung gnas nas gzab gasku/la rgyas pa zhig 'bul gnang mdzad nyin 7gong sa mchog dang /sku'i yongs 'dzin rin po che rnam gnyis snunags mabo na du chibs bsgyur skabs srid bkas ma〉rgan gzhung zhabs skya ser yongs rdzogs chibs zhabs su bcar te skyabacar phan bde legs bshad gling tshogs yongs nas zhal 'don dang /gtong yul las khungs so sos bskang tshogs kyi dgos cha rnams btang ste rta dbyangs rol cha dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'khor bskang bshags rme nga' gsol dang bcas la snga dro tshogs thun ring ba gcig thog grub pa mdzad cing /de'i skabs lha sa ba pho mo shin tu mang po rgyan gos gzab mchor ldan pa nas dpal lha rtsog steng bsangs gsol dud sprin gyis lha lam 'gengs pa lta bu yong /

2/klu sbug sgar sgrig——ra༅༅//bod zla tshes 22nyin klu sbag gam klu sgug thang du gur gyis sgar btab/de nyin ya sor spyi khyab pa rshanyis kyi na gza' gos rgyan gzhi ser po 'brug chen rgyab mdun gnyis su ker langs byas pa dang /sked rags gser khebs/'o/ra shubs bo/sa cho na khra mtshal /rgya gri dang /rgya khugadabu zhwa wa sgor/zhabs cag 'ja' mtshal sku/gas dang /ya gasku/ga ngo las dang bcas pa bla steng bka' shag gi dbu g.yab cordog bcar/'bras tshogs chen dge bskos nas blang dor byed sgo'i tshogs gtam zin 'phral bka' blon rnam pa'i khongs nas bka' blon khri pas ya sor ngo las la klu jig snar sgrig nas bzung grol ston bar byed blo'i bka' bsgyur gnang zin bstun ya sor ngo las rnams jo tho'i dbu skra nas rta chibs te sngon bskyod nas jus yag dar chen la snyan shal khro gas te g.yas btsā ra gyis klu sgug sgar bsgrigs kyi dbu gur sar phebs skabs lam gyi g.yas gasku na dang /dbu gur mdo sbug gang sar gzhung zhabs dang mi mang bcas nas ltad mo blta bar 'tshang ga shig shig sku nga srol la/dbu gur gyi bzhugs khri'i lnga ga bzhugs nyid gsol ja/bzhes 'bras btegs/mchod chang phud gtor

22zhu mi rgyan bzang ma zhes sngar lugs bud med lo phra mdzes ma gnyis dang /rgyan gasku/ga gnyis/ khrung zhu ma gnyis/ khrung gasku/ga gnyis bcas sku/da rgyan bzang mas na bza' lha sa rgya se thi'u rgya smag dang / rgya se 'ja' sgrig steng rtsag zhig ra klo phreng / dkar shal/ domar shal/ e kor brum 'dzar ga'u/ ga'u gsum sgom/ mu tig thu khog mu tig dang / byu ru'i phreng ba/ gzi phrug dang / gser gyi bcu shad/ gser gyi lag gdub/pha lam dang / pad rag yin dra ni la bcas kyi phra ldan tshigs khebs/lha ra bu dga' 'khyil/ 'ba' khug khab shabs/ rtse g.yu'i thag pa tho sa zan sne lnga lham rta so ma/ 'og 'jug ༄ston sma lnga / rgyan g.yog la mu thig thu khog meng cing / de min 'dra ba na bza' cung zher/ khrung g.yog byon gos de las ther ba/ rta dom gnyis brtsegs chibs rags rnams kyi sngon bskyo da chang rgyab pa zhes khyo ga gos rgyan gzhi ser po dang / kha gyon 'bo mtshal/ zhwa 'bog 'ja' lham rgya cig lag tu 'tshang bshangs rta lcag 'khyer ba/ rtar os dom/ ya song brda gtong pas brda btang bstun 'dam brgyad the ga ngang ya gasku ga bcas b.la' bskyar zhu bcar la/ ya sor bgres pas nga lta sbag dam rtsa tshigs rin po che sgrogs sbyang gnang rgyu yin zhes/ snu gas bkadro gnang / ya sor gzhon pas/ sbag dam mtshigashā sgrogs sbyang gnang mjus ya sor bgres pas da lnga zlog dam rtsa tshigs rin sngo che cadags sbyang gnang ba las lhag pa mi 'dug skyong / gal che nan dpe bzhin dbu g.yab codag nas sa dbang 7mi rje lhan rgyas kyi bka'i phebs sgo 'a/'ang khyod rang ya sor spyi khyab pa 'es che ba'i rtags dang / lung gis

23mngags pa zhig yin na zhu sbru/ rnams 'thus tshang dbo/sa rgyu'i bka' bsgyur spyi phebs dgongs don/ da ring klu sbug sgar sgrig nas bzung grol ston bar sngar srol rta dmag dang / rkang dmag nas byed sgo'i stor 'di ltar yin zhes re re bzhin skad gsang malnga na sgyu sa bka' bsgur nan 'the mas gnang / sto

24gra phyi rtsis bsher/———ra༅༅/ /bod zla 1 tshes 23nyin gra phyi rtsis bsher zhes gra bzhi'am gra phyi thang la gzhung gi gur pa nas bka' shag sdu gas kyi dbu gur dang /gdan gnyer nas bzhugs gdan/ bka' shag gasku/la thab nas garu/la ja bzhes 'bras/ bla brang phyag mdzod nas gsol ston sha 'bras/ gsol bskangs g.yog dar bcas gra bsgrigs sngon ltar/ ya sku ra spyi khyab ngo las dang / srung ma dmar nag gi rten mdung gdan zhu dang 'brel klu sbag sgar sa nas/ rta dmag ru nyis gshibs kyis po tu la zhol gyi mdun bskarla bzang zam pa brgyud/ rdo ring phyi mar g.yas bskor gyis lcang gseb shar dang /rgod gseb shar brgyud/ rwa sgreng gling ma'i zur nas gra phyi thang du ru bsgrigs kyis bskyod de bka' shag dang / chibs zhabs shod skor drung 'khor tshang ma bcas chibs bsgyur gyis bzhugs 'a|/da mtshams ga11la ja bzhes 'bras phebs/ de nas ya 11ra spyi khyab gnyis nas gu shī'i chas betas rgya se'i khal kha gzugs/ dbu zhwa sbu khru bzhes pa'i ya sku ra bgres pas g.yas ru'i rta gzhung mjal dar sbrags bka' shag gso/la lcog steng phul rjes srung ma dmar nag gi rten mdung gdan zhu zhusate dmag rnams bka' shag gzigs

25lam du ru bsgrigs te bskyod skabs/ rtsis khang las khungs nas rta dmag gi dmag gzhung nang gsal rtsis bsher snyan sgron zhus te/ rta pa gtong khungs so so'i rta pa'i grangs 'bor thon mtshams shod drung gcig dngari /rtsis phrug pa nas zhib bsher gyis zin 'phral bka' shag sku mdun du shod drung nas bcar te phyag 'bul zhus te ngag lam nas ga las ru dang po sde dpon dga' bzhi pa'i gzab 'asnga na dang bcas rta pa 25 'grigs lags zhes zhus/ de mjug mu mthud rtsis phrug pa gcig nas/ rta shed bzang / mi bo thang / rta sga sga 'alto ra cha lag cha tshang dang bcas 'grigs lags/ yang rtsis phrug pa gcig nas gu gu'i a spro ga kha sha'i sha ro/ra/ dpa' dam/ 'u thu'u su/ mgo shubs kha gsar/ rta mdung so rnga dang bcas 'grigs lags zhes dang / yang rtsis phrug pa gcig nas sog me gzhu mdong / 'ja' lham/ re/ 'o/nga bzhi'i mtha' spras byang khebs dang bcas 'grigs lags zhes zhus/ de bzhin rta tho ༄/na rim bzhin zhib bsher snyan sgron gong ltar zhus/ g.yas ru rtsis bsher grub rjes shin dgung gsol tshigs gzhung gnas nas rgyu gdodang gis bka' shag gsol thab nas sku 'kho ra tshang mar gasku/la ja dang / gsol tshigs sha 'bras 'bul srol bzhin bka' shag dbu gur zur sku da la chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ ya sku/ra khri pa sku gas khungs 11 so'i dbu gur yod rigs daX gur la gsol tshigs su phebs/ shod sgor gzhung zhabs byings la mdzad sgo'i dbu gur rang du gsol cigs btang / gsol tshigs grub mtshams slar yang tshang ma dbu gur du phebs mtshamasagasku na ru'i rta dmag gzhung khra ya sor gzhon pas gsol stsog steng phul rjes rtsis

26khang las khungs nas gzhung khra nang gsal snyan sgron dang / shod drung rtsis phrug pa nas zhib bsher snyan sgron gong gsal ltar zhus/ g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis kyi rta gzhung nang gsal mjug bsgril zin ma tshams rtsis khang las khungs nas ya sku ra spyi khyab gnyis kyis mtshon rta dmag rnams la legs dar re g.yogs te bka' shag sku mdun du thugs rje che zhu'i phyag 'bul zhus/ de nas ya sor spyi khyab ngo las nas g.yas ru dang / g.yon ru'i sne 'khrid rten mdung dang / rta dmag rnams ru bsgrigs kyis ra mo che'i mdun/ rje 'bum sgang / klu sgug sgar sgrig sar phyir bskyod byed/

blo na lam galta ra rgyag ge rter༅༅/ /bod zla 1 tshes 24 snga dro gnas chung chos rgyal chen po rnying nas bar skor nang 'khor brgyud smon lam skam tshogs su dga' ldan khri rin po che'i sku mdun du phebs te mjal rten mdzad nas jo shaka rnam gnyis 1/gas rten gatho khag la gnas gzigs mdzad/ de nyin lha ldan sdugan lam chen mo'i rjes 'brel gtor rgyag tu rta dmag dang gzim sbyong pa gnyis bskyod dgos par de nyin ya sor spyi khyab na bza' rgya se glang chen tshang 'khor gyi khal kha gzugs dang / dbu zhwa sbu khru sogs dang / rten mdung gdan zhu/ ru khag g.yas gasku na gyi rta dmag rnams sne 'khrid chodal bskal bzang zam pa nas/ rdo ring phyi ma/ rtsodad gseb shar/ dbang chen gling ga'i zur brgyud ra che'i mtshams nas g.yas ru gling bskor spyodan bo nga zam pa/rgya lha khang / de nas tho ra khang / na shar rgyud dang / gasku na ru ra che nas/rme ru'i mdun brgyud gling bskor rgya lha khang / de nas sde tha'i brgyud/ kun rtse'i sgo 'gram nas bskyod de g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis gdong zur du dus 'dzoms dang 'brel khrung zhu mas phud gtor zhus/ bla rnying mdun bzhugs khri nyon ༄/na sar bzhugs zhabs 'khebad/ ga1/la ja/ bzhes 'bras/

28rgyan bzang mas slar yang phud galta ra zhus te phyag 'bul zhus/ nye 'brel 1/gas mi mang nas ya 1/ra cad las zhabs gras dang bcas par legs dar shog 'dzar dang sbrags 'tshang ga shig shig 'bul srol/ bod ljongs stod bcud yongs kyi bdag po 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gtor gzigs su bla steng gzim chung zur 'phyong du chibs bsgyur grub yod med ya gasku/ga nas cardon gseng zhus te/ grub mtshams ya lha/ra spyi khyab gnyis kyis rta dmag rnams sne 'khrid sa khrag sgang du phebs mtshams chibs bshol gyi 'bras cho gas chen dge balha sa gnyis dang / zhang po shing gnyer/ chab dam pa/ ya sor bcas jo lha'i dbu skra'i tshad rdo'i mtshams dal bu'i thog nas gom gsum sgos te zhwa phud kyis sku phyag gsum phul te slar yang gom gsum phyir bshig byas te de nas sa theg sgang bar bskyod/ lha sa'i mi dpon gnyis dang / gzim sbyong pa'i 'go pa zla gcig drung 'khor nas sne 'khrid rkang dmag gzim rjodang pa zhes pa sngar lugs lcags zhwa/ lcags kyi bo/ khrab/phub/ mda' gzhu sag thag snga mo'i sngo da mda' rang 'grigs 500stor nas jo tho'i dbu skra'i mdun du go rtsed gzigs 'bul zhus/ spyi nor 7gong sa chen po'i sku phya dang / bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde skyid kyi ched dmigs sku bcar phan /de legs bshad gling dang / 'bras sngags pa grwa tshang gnyis nas gtor sgrub zor 'phen du phebs skabs sngon du rnam grwa dang /sngags grwa'i gtor ma dang phyag dar nye logs ser sngags kho ngas mi gzab mchor ldan pa nas gdan zhu/ gtor rgyab tu dga' ldan khri rin 1༄ rdo dang /de'i phebs zhabs su lo de'i lha rams dge bshes bcu drug gnas chung

30lha rams mtshan rtags ang rim gzim sgo'i 'khris mkhan drung sku bgres nas gzhung khra skad gsang mthon pos sgrogs sbyang dang 'brela.ang rim dang por rtse'aphral bde las khungs nas gnang cha zhwa ser dang / snam sbyar sogs legs dar nang mdzod/ ang gnyis gsum la zhwa ser dang / ja 'khor drug legs dar a she/ 'phros lha rams tshang mar legs dar thub phyi re gnang ste thugs rje che zhu'i phyag 'tshal zhus/ gzhung zhabs ser skya rnams galta ra rgyag ma zin bar bzhugs/ gdo/ra rgyag zin 'phral drung bzhes cadal/ya sor ngo las rta dmag rnams klu sbug sgar sgrig sar bskyod//

3/byams pa gdan 'dren/——ra༅༅/ /bod tshes 25 nyin ya sor gnyis na bza' tshon khra mchod bzhes kyis byams pa gdan 'dren zhes pa ma cardongs bskal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa 7rgyal ba mi pham mgon pa 'i bstan pa 'char rgya'i rten 'brel slad gtsug lag khang gi mchod khang sgo ma'i rten gtso byams༄ mgon sku brnyan shing rta 'kho ra lo'i steng du gdan drangs/ gdugs da nga / g.yas gasku na du rgyal mtshan dang phye phur 11gas kyis brgyan te gdan zhus/ 'khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor mdun du dge slong brgyad gras khrus gsol/ de nas rme gzhis kyi dge 'dun mas mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i ser phreng bis sngan bsus te bar ༄/ra du gdan zhus skabs snang shag 'khris/ byams khaskreng gi mdun ngos gos sku 'grems gnang mdzad pa'i sku mdun du rgyal ba byams pa phebs ma/tshams gnas chung cesas rgyal chen 11 ma〉〉ga nas 'tshams zhu'i sgron dar 'bul lam zhu gnang mdzad nas byams pa sgos sne thung tsam ring gdan 'dren zhu gnang mdzad/ de nas chos skyong sngon du bar stor brgyud zur 'phyong rab gsal 'og phebs pa dang / rtsezhod sku tshab bla phyag bcas nas zhal ja dang / sgron dar mthun rdzas bcas 'bul gnang mdzad/ de

32nas khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor nas gar pas bsu sna phul rgyu dang chos skyong nas gar pa tshor gnang cha stsal/ ser skya mi mang nas 7snyan dar grangs las 'das pa phul/ gsung chos ra bar phebs mtshams rme rnying nas khyams ra'i lho sgobargyud gnas chung chos skyong phebs te snyan dar 'bul gnang mdzad/ bla phyag las khungs nas zhal ja lha na dar phul/ byams mabo na sa 1/ga snang du phebs mtshams klu sbug dang / cadal/ bar ma ri bcas nas gnam lcags me rje gas gsum rim len gyis brgyab stogasum pa'i mtshams dan 'bag gi mdun nas/ rgyugs ring spyi khyab rim bzhi dang / las bya chibs che/ rgyugs ma zhal ngo bcas nas gzhung sgor gyi rgyugs rta rnams dus gcig tu thod/ de bstun ya sna'i ri zur nas mi rgyugs lho da/ bar ma ri zur nas bar rgyugs zhes pa mi rta rang 'grigs rnams bskyod/ rta rgyugs/ mi rgyugs/ bar rgyugs rnams rtsepho brang gi mdun lam chen brgyud lha sa'i gsung chos ra ba'i mdun nas 'gro zhing / de skabs spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen 11 masnangag rgyugs gzigs su chibs bsgyar gyi chibs zhabs su gzhung zhabs yongs rdzogs dang bcas gsung chos gā ba'i zur 'phyong gzim chung du zhabs 'kho da kyis gzigs/zhib bkrin bskyangs/ bar rgyugs rnams gzigs lam du 'khyodar mtshams rta sngo ga nas gus btud kyi rta rtsal rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston cing / de skabs jo bo rags rgyag bi zur nas rta pa 'byor snga rting gi shing byangayang rim sprod mi sku tshab dza tha'i gcig dang /las bya/ chibs che/ bka' shag sku tshab bcas phebs tetso5nga rim gnang /mi rgyugs rnam sa la bla rnying mdun nasa.ang rim sprad de sku tshab rnams nas

33rta tho dang / mi rgyugs kyi rbha gzhung 7snyan zhur phur/ snyan zhu lam 'phral cadan rgyur de mtshams bka' shag sku tshab bka' drung dang / gnang cha legs dar snre da mi bla phyag ngo las bcas nas gzigs lam bsam pho'i mdun bskal bzang dar chen 'khris shing stegs mthon po'i steng nas zhal pho brang du phyogs rbe bka' drung nas thog mar rta tho dang / de myo jug mi rgyugs kyi tho klog bla phyag nas sngar lam gzengs dar dang gos sna'i tshan grangs/ja 'kho ra drug sogs song gsal sprad de dar chen la g.yas bskor gyis khungs so sku ra log rgyugs ring spyi khyab nas rtsegazim 'gag tu zhu sgo rnams 'thus tshang byung lugs snyan gseng zhus 'phral phyag srung stsal te thugs rje che zhu'i sku phyag phul/ de'i skabs rta pa rnams phyir log ma 'byor ba'i dbar zur 'phyong gzim chung spyan lam 'og tu gzim sbyong pa rkang dmag g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis kyi mi stobs shugs can gcer hrang gnyis re nas shugs rtsala.ab thang tshad pa ('gran pa ) dang / gyon pa yo da pa 'ga' shas nas mon gnyis lhag tsam gyi ljid yod pa'i rdo ril 'khyer 'gyogs kyis bskal bzang dar chen la ba༄/ra ba lan ba nyi/ sa tsam rgyab sku nga / de dag la bla phyag las khungs nas skabs sku/ sor gzengs dar gnang 10la sku/da/snga sdu'i mdzad sgo de dag grub rjes 'bras tshogs chen zhal ngo rwa las lha ldan bla steng gzim chung 'gag tu thon phyas zhus te lam seng 'bras spungs su phyir 'og byed cing / blon lam las bya ba rnams kyis las ma/jug tshang ma de shin rang la gtsang mar zin pa byas te sang shin byed 'ophro gtan nas ma ྅khushaṃ pa byed dgos pa bcas de phyin nas blon lam chen rokhelags par grol zin pa red//

34rtsodang rgyab zhar 'phen/——༄༅༅/ /bod zla 1 tshes 26 nyin rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen zhes lda klu'i mdun sngo sa bka' shag dang / gzhung zhabs rnams kyi dbu gur gur pas sngon sgron sar bka' blon rnam pa dang / shod skor khongs gtogs las dkyus yan phebs te bla phyag las khungs nas rgyu 'awa/ btang ste gasku/la ja/bzhes 'bras/ ga1/la tshigs sku gas gra sgrig zhus/ ya sku ra spyi khyab thog las nas rta pa rnams sne 'khrid kyis lca klu'i mdun ngos bcar te ya sor spyi khyab bgres pas ga(5sa ru'i rta bzhung bka' sdugan lhan rgyas kyi gso/la 44ga bang phul te 'ol las nang zan gocig nas sku mdun du zhwa phud sgur te bsdad par bka' blon bgres pas ṅge gzhung gi rta pa'i gtong khungs dang grangs 'a3per bka' khyab grub nyid nang zan nas skad gsang mthon sngo sa dper na gajigs ru dang sngo sdo dpon dga' ba'i ba'i gzab 'dirme dang bcas rta pa 25zhes brjod de rta thog nas mda' me ma dung gsum rtsal 'gran bzang zhan gyis bka' shag sku mdun du bstar bsgrigs mtshams bla phyag nas legs dar gnang ste phyag 'bul zhus te phyir log de nas mu mthud rtsed 'gran rta pa rnams la gong bzhin gzengs dar gnang ste g.yas ru'i rta pa rdzogs

35mazurgams/ bka' sdu/na rnam pa dang / gzhung zhabs bcas gasku/la :rgyags zur yod du phebs/ bka' blon rnam par rtse gsol thab nas ja zhu phebs/ga1/la cinags grub mtshams ya 1/ra galha/na pas gasku/na ru'i gzhung khra phul te gong bzhin gzengs bstod re stsal/ de nyin lha zhol mi mang ji snyed ltad mo dang sbrags spro skyid gtong bar yong srol dang / mdzad sgo grub mtshams ya so/ra spyi khyab dang / tho las nas bka' blon rnam par phyag 'bul zhus/spyi khyab ngo las dang / rta pa rnams rtsepho brang sku rgyab mkhar rnga gdong brgyud skar sar bskyod skabs lha zhol mi mang ltad mor ji snyed yong /

36gnaspu/ phyo/da'/——༄༅༅/ /bod zla 1 tshes 27 nyin gnam mda' zhes lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i mdzad sgo legs par grub pa'i tsakres bde legs kyi grol ston chen mo'i nyin sngar srol lha klu'i mdun gzhung gi spro khang zur sku da la bka' shag dang / chibs zhabs mo da cadar sku ngas snyu gas phebs/bka' shag gasku/la thab nas gasku/la ja bzhes 'bras phul rjes ya gasku/ga rnams rta b.rā na te rgyug rtsal thog nas 'ben la mda' 'phen dang / de mjug bka' shag gi gzigs lam shod drung gnyis nas shing stegs shig gi ste nga langs te skad gsang mthon pos dbyangs dang bcas te 'di ltar brjod/ dpung bzang mda' pa'i tshogs rnam sa nyon/ rgyang ma cha red/ 'ju thal ya red/ mda' bzang po rna mas mda' yig zha la shog cig wa ye/ 'es lan gnyis brjod de mda' pa rnams kyi mdar shāka' drung nas 1/ so'i ming yig bkod de rgyang ma rtsal 'gran byed/ de skabs rtsegasol thab nas bka' shag la ja zhu dang / dkar spro lnga brtsegs phebs/ sku srung gzim pa rnams gzigs mthongs gral la 'khod de ja thug gi ston mo gzab rgyas stsal/ mda' rgyang ma dang / 'ju thal so so'i ring tshad kyi ang rim ji thob ya

37sor gnyis dang / bka' drung gcig phebs te ang tho bkod nas bka' ldan la slan 'bul zhus/ de nas bka' shag 10 khang gzim chung du gasku la tshigs la phebs/ 'di nyin bka' shag la gsol ston sgrog rtse gzab rgyas shig dang / gzhung zhabs shod skor byings la kha che sha 'bras gzab legs shig bcas bla phyag nas 'bul dalha sa/ gasku la tshigs grub rjes slar yang tshang ma spro khang dbu g.yab tu phebs 'phral gsol ja zhig phebs/ mda' rgyang ma'i ang tho bka' drung nas klog ste bla phyag nas tshan grangs dang /legs dar stsal/ de nas bka' blon sku skya bo rnams kyi dbu zhwa brjes te sog zhwa dmar po bzhes/ zhol gnyer nas dngul phor nang bka' lhan la khrung g.yang phud gtor pus btsugs kyis zhus rjes gzhung zhabs mchod chang bzhes mi dang / bi shu rtsal 'gran byed mi rnams la dngul phor nang khrung zhu mas macesad chang yang yang zhu zhing / bi shu rgyag mi cho sa lhas dbang rnam par nang tsha phul te 'ben la phog na las dbang rnam par mchod chang btegs pa dgyes mnyes kyis bzhes dgos yong / yang bi shu 'ben la ho/ga mi rnams la las dbang rnam pas legs chang stsal ba khrung zhu mas zhus te sku mdun du pus btsugs kyis 'thung dgos/ bla phyag nas 'phral 'phral tsha dar sprad pa ske rags la gzer bas mda' tsha po rnams la dgong dro kha btags kyis sham thabs lta bu chags yong / de skabs gzhung gi zlos gar ba gar pa dang gar phrug rnams nas rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs tshang ba'i rol dbyangs snyan zhing 'jebs pa dang / gar glu bcas btang bas bde ba'i nyams kyis thugs ther ba lta bu yong / dbong dro nyi rgas mtshams mdzad

38sgo grol khar bla phyag nas shing 'bras bka' blon rnam par rgya lcog re dang /de byings la tha spag bzhi brtsegs dang / tha spag 3/da bar tho thob kyis phul/ bka' sdu na rnam pa'i shing 'bras gar phyag par stsal/ bla phyag nas bka' blon rnam par mgul dar nang mdzod dri bral dang / rim sras yan la.a she/ de byings la zub she/ de bzhin rtsis khang nas mjal dar re phul/ de nas chibs jo ga gzim shag tu ma phebs bar mjal dar mgul bzhes thog gar phrug pas rol cha gtong bzhin par phebs/ gzim spyong pa rnams khag babo sa kyis bka' sdu na so/ so'i gzim shag bar sku srung gis phebs skyel zhu grol bcas smon lam rjes 'brel grol khyon bcas legs par grub pa red//

tshogs mchod chen mo/——༄༅//bod zla 2tshes 9nyin tshogs mchod chen mo zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid mtshan brjod par dka' ba 7gong sa lnga pa chen po ji btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde dpal bzang po'i dgongs rdzogs su sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos cho 'phrul smon lam dang cha 'dra ba'i chogs mchod smon lam gyi mchod 'bul 'di bzhin 'phar 'dzugs mdzad pa zhig yin cing /de'i ring gsol tshogs sa phebs mi dge 'dan dang /gzhung gnas rki ja thug gtong sgo/'bras rang dag rig tshogs chen dge skos kyi dbang tshad sogs smon lam chen mo dang 'dra rung /gdan sa khag gi dge 'dun 14ngas nas tre/gas mthar phebs mi rnams phebs zin pa'i dbang gis 'dus cho gas smon lam nang bzhin gyi mang po rang mi yong yang /dge bshes dam bca' 'jog mi tshogs rams pa brgyad yod/tshes 25nyin dgongs rdzogs kyi tshes cha dngos gzhir brten gzhung gi ja thug sku/gas gzab rgyas dang 'brel sngar lam bla phyag nas gzhung gi sku 'gyed ṭam dkar re dang /rtse gzim chung nas spyan gsal sku 'gyed ṭam dkar re dang /gasku la ja/bzhes thug 'bras tsha bcas sku nga //

40glud 'gong rgyal po/——༄༅༅/ /tshes 29 nyin gsang sngags (rnying ma ) byang chub gling pa'i tshogs yongs nas rnying lugs gtor sgrub dang 'brel ba'i 7rgyal ba'i sku glud du mi gson po'i glud 'gong rgyal po'i gzugs gnyis dang / sku glud gtor bzlog bcas rgyag cing / de'i skabs khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor 'og tu byang chub gling gi slob dpon dang / glud 'gong gnyis sho mig 'gran bsdur byed/ sku tshab tu rnam grwa'i sku zhabs dbu paṇa dang / sku ber/ stong chab kyi lha ma ra balha na pa zhig dang bka' shag gi sku tshab bka' shag sna da pa gnyis bcas sku da cing / 7rgyal ba'i sku tshab dang / byang chub gling pa'i slob dpon gnyis la bzhugs khri chung chung re dang / gsol lcog re sku da/ gzhan rnams bzhengs te bzhugs dgos/ sho'i che chung ni byang chub gling pa'i slob dpon gyi sho'i zhing tshad ngos rer dbyin ci phyed gnyis tsam gyi gru bzhi dkar po mig gcig nas drug bar yod pa dang / glud 'bo nga gi snan che chung be/nga mtshungs nag po mig gnyis rkyang rkyang yin yang / zur 'debs su ang ki chung chung gcig nas drug bar bkod yod pa red/ de ni ltad mo ba mi shin tu mang po mtha' sgor du khengs bsdad yod stabs gsang

4/thabs kyi dgos pa zhig yin pyored/ byang gling slob dpon gyi sho ni gsol lcog thog steng khebs sgron pa'i steng du 'phen cing / glud 'gong gi sho byang slob kyi gsol lcog mdun ldo bcal steng ras nas cig bting ba'i steng du 'phen gyi yod pa red/ sho mig che chung (mang nyung ) rtse'i sku tshab dang /bka' shag sku zurgab gaphrinas nas gzigs te bka' shag sku zurgab nas gsang rtags dacadas 'brel gyi grangs de sam khra'i sngo ga bris te bka' shag brgyud gzim chung 7snyan zhur 'bul dbo sa/ gal srid glud 'tho nga gi sho mig ang gsal la rgyal kha sngo ba tshe lo der 7rgyal ba'i sku phya dang / chab srid la ngan dogs sku da pas 'bas rim rgya che gnang sku la /dug sho rgyag zin rjes glud 'gong de dag khro bo'i zhal 'bag gyon pa'i ha la rnams kyis ded de gcig ra sgang brgyud bsam yas dang / gcig 'phan sngo lha la brgyud glud 'gong sgang du 'gro dgos/ rgyab tu byang gling gi gtor rgyag sha gsar sgang du rgyag de mjug rgyud smad gatho ra rgyag klu sgug tu rgyag skabs gnas chung ce sa rgyal chen po yang galta ra rgyab tu phebs/ de dang dus mtshungs rgyud stod nas ra che'i ltag tu gtor rgyag zhig dang / gong dkar chos sdes kho ma khang rgyab tu galta ra rgyag gcig bcas de nyin rang la rgyag pa red//

4tshogs mchod ser sbrengs/ge zher༅༅//bod zla 2tshes 30nyin dpal ldan 'bras spangs dgon pa'i rgyab ri bya rgod phung po'i ri dang gnyis su medapa'i dge 'chal dbu rtser rta bdun dbang pe'i 'od zer 'phros ma thag tshogs mchod ser sbrengs chen mo'i mchod rdzas las bya sngon bskyod pa na bza' gzab 'phor dang 'brel ba'i sgos snes sngan bsus te/'phyar dar 'khyer mi dang po bde yangs bstan pa dar rgyazlo kyis sna drangs te mchod rdzas kyi bye brag rnam grangs shin tu mang zhing bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dngos po rnying ma rin bral srid na dasna/na pa rnams go rim ma 'a1 la ba 'phyar 'khyer mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ji bzhin dal brel lha mas shing /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'phyor mdun mchod 'bul dang /de nas bar skor byang chub 'byon lam brgyud g.yas babye/ra gyis klu sbag rgyal tsā /g.yu smra/ga zam pa/྅/la rdo ring snang du ser sbrengs dang po phedros pa dang /7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen sngo mchog 'o/brang dmar wa'i gzim chung sa gsum du zhabs sor 'khod/rtse 'o/ brang sku mdun du gos sku'i zhal thang chen mo dpang la phi kri 250tsam sku/da pa de dag bkram ste zhal dbye phebs bde mda' ma dang bstun ser

43sbrengs dang / lta rtog pa/ mchod rdzas do dam ngo las/ 'bras tshogs chen dge skos/ zhang spro shing gnyer/ chab dam pa/ dge g.yog thab gasku/ga sku/gas las bya rnams gzab 'aX ra gyis gral bstar dal bus smra/ tu la zhol gyi gzhung sgo brgyud nas bcar bskyod dang 'brel/ khang steng gos sku rin po che'i sku mdun du mchod 'bul la phebs/ de'i skabs dge slong dza khag cig nas zhal 'asnga na co gas zhing spyan 'dren gyis khrus galha/la zhu ba dang / bka' shag gdan gnyer dang / gur pas dbu gur sngon sgron sar bka' shag dang / las dkyus yan zhal mjal du phebs te sdu/ so'i gdan tho ba gral la 'khod/ gasku la ja/ bzhes 'bras sogs rim phebs lnga ga ser sbrengs rnams mchod pa'i bye brag spro phyir rgyud sde bzhi nas bstan pa'i ma〉kyid gar ma tshang ba med pa tshang ma 'asnga na dbyangs dang bcas te 'khrab pa dang / rnga rol/ dung rgya/ sbab dkrol gnang bzhin rim bskyod kyis dkyil gdugs dkar wa'i mtsharmermi gnas chung chos rgyal chen sngo spyan 'dren sku phebs kyis spyi nor 7gong sa chen po mchog dang / gos skur phyag 'tshal pad 'bul dang 'brel bo sa skur snyan shar 'bul gnang gis zhabs stegs thog 'khod 'phral ba glang rdzi bo nas 'o phud btegs pa dang / gnas chung chos rgyal chen pos phyag mdud dang / mjal dar stsal/ sku ngang bzhugs ring bla phyag nas zhal ja/ gser phud dang rtse'i sgron dar mgron brgyud kyis stsal/ bka' drung bgres pas bka' shag gi lung zhu 7snyan cadan la bka' lung dang / mu mthud bka' shag dang / dza tha'i/ 14gas mda'/rtsis sras/ las tshan/ las dkyus/ 'bras snurags chen dge stodas blo

44las sogs nas sgron dar phul/ 〉kyis lha nga nas glang po cher zhal dodag dang / legs dar stsal/ glang chen gyis gus btud zhus te phyir phebs skabs gar phyag pa rnams nas mjal kha zhus te gar phrug par codas lha/nga nas gnang cha stsal/ sku sangs/ ser phreng rnams gral bstar rim phebs kyis rtse pho brang sku rgyab klu khang du mjug sgril mtshams gos sku gser thang chen mor dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams nas rab gnas shis brjod zin 'phral bos sku bsgril bsdu zhu/ mchod rdzas ngo las rnams dang / ser phreng gdan mi rnams kyang rdzong rgyab gling sha'i nang du sku ngal chu tshod gnyis tsam ring mdzad skabs 10 so'i gzim khang nas gasku la tshigs gang rgyas 'bul phebs mchod bzhes kyis tā da bzhugs gnang / de nas mchod rdzas wa dam pa'i brda dang bstun sngar ltar gral bstar gyis gling sgor lam brgyud ra che gtsug lag bang du mchod 'bul dang 'brel rje 'bum sgang / phur phyog bla brang /sha gsar sgang / jo bo'i dbu skra bcas brgyud khyams ra'i nang 'phyar dar dang po nas bzung gral bsngar gyis phyir log skabs mchod rdzas drung yig nas gzhung khra nang gsal zhib bsher zab nan gyis de 'phral tri sa len byas te khungs so so'i mchod 'khyer phyir slog gtong ba bcas ser sbrengs chen mo'i mdzad ༄༄ nag mtha' bar gsum legs par grub nyid dgong ja tshogs te bla phyag nas dge 'dun la legs dar re dang / sku 'gyed ṭam dkar re phul te chosags mchod chen mo legs par grol zin pa red//

59chod lha na gzhas phud/— zhe༄7/ /bod zla 6 tshes 29 nyin 'o ston sgo dbye'i gzigs phud yin/ zho ston zhes pa ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa rin po che de 'dzin dang bcas pa'i mnga' bdag 7gong sa 7skya bas mgon chen pos dbus gdan gsum dang / gling phan tshun tshang ma'i mkhan ྅/ bla sprul gyis masnu na dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde rnams dbyar gnas zhal bzhes kyi skabs su bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis bstan pa la bar chad mi 'jug pa'i ched bdud sder gtogs dang bcas pa spro ba bskyed pa'i slad 'dod chos dang mthun par dbyar zhal bzhes kyi dkyil du 'phags pa'i co〉sa dang mi mthun pa'i rnam pa macadan gsal can zhig lha na dbo sa pa sku/gas datho sa pa du ma zhig yod 'dug pa ltar gong tshes kyi snga dro lha mo ba 'bag dkar po 'phyong rgyas span bdun pa dang / yar lung bkrisacu lapa/ snye mo ba/ snang rtse ba rnams thos sne drangs lha mo rjon pa ba rgyal mkhar chos rdzong dang /shangs ri bo che pa/ gcung ri bo che pa/ skyor mo lung pa/ be rong 'brong rtsed/ bro pa sogs nas dang por rtsepho brang dang / de nas nor gling / dgong sngo 'bras spungs 'o/ brang bcas par lha mo'i glu gar gyi gzigs phud phul//

60'bras spungs zho ston/——༄thob/ /bod zla 6 tshes 30 nyin snga dro dge 'phel dbu rtser nyi shar mtshams 'bras spangs dgon pa'i nub ngos ri ldebs gos sku khang du ston pa thub pa'i dbangag du gtso gyur gyi sku brnyan yod pa'i gos sku 'grems ston gyi mchod 'bul sar 'bras tshogs chen dge sgos gsar rnying brje len gnang skabs sngar srol gyi rim pa khag dang / zlos gar lha mo ba rnams nas gos sku'i spyan sngar gzigs phud rim bzhin 'khrab 'bul zin pa dang /de nas lha mo ba rang rang gi 10ba khungs khang tshan sku 10ra rgyal rabs 'dra min lha mo nyin 'khyongs 'khrab len byed cing / 'di'i nyin gos ma'i zhal ma/jal dang / ltad mo blta bar ser skya ji rtsed yong gi yod cing ༄/ de nyin gnam gang yin pas dge 'dun dang / sku mabo/na tshang mar gasku/la cirgags dkar skyong 'o 'bras gtong bar brten zho don zhes tha snyad chags tshod 'duga'abras spangs dge 'dun tsho'i shag tshang sku sku ra lda chodal khul sku/gas nas 'brel rtsed mgron 'bod dang / de min lha mo'i gzigs mor phebs mkhan lha chodal mi mang dang / snye stodar grong gseb pa sogs gzab mchor byas rbe cesang mkhan shin tu mang tho/ sku/nga /

6/se ra zho ston/hozhe༄༅༅/ /gong tshes 30 nyin se ra dgon par yang se ra zho ston zhes se ra cergyags chen kyi ༄/ 'aX ra canag tu gnas srung bya khri spyan gcis sku rten gyi khog gzhir spyan 'dren zhus/ chos sde chen po se ra theg chen gling gi bla spyi'i ma khan po bla sprul dge 'dun yongs nas mjal kha zhus te sgron dar phu la/ lha 'a〈per ru 'dren rnams nas 'chams rgyab par gzigs ce/ gzigs/bla spyis lung zhu phul bar codas lha nga gis bstan pa dang / yul spyi'i bde thabs stor la lung bstan dang / brtag gzhi zhes dngos rdzas 'dra mi 'dra sna snu gas la go ba rgyag rgyu yod pa'i bzo dbyibs lung bkod gnang ste bcos dgos pa dang / drung yig nas de dag chod bsna da byas pa'i yi ge nas tshang mas ma 'ongs yu la gyi bde sdug bo ba len datho sa shing / 'di la dmigs bsal gzhung 'brel che ba med kyang / lha sa ba spyir btang dang / bye brag se ra dgon spyi'i srung ma zhig red/ gong gsal /rma shar chos skyong gi ru 'dren rnams nas bod zla 7 tshes 1 zhogs pa snga char rtse pho brang dang / de nas nor gling pho brang du 'chams phud ba/zigs 'bu la zhu dgos kyis ru 'dren dang las sne rnams nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du bcar te se ra 'o sdon

62skabs kyi gnas srung bya khri'i lung bstan shog lte 7gong sa chen por mgron brgyud snyan 'bul thog lha 'khor ru 'dren rnams nas pho brang gzigs mthongs gdengs cha'i steng du 'chams phud gzigs 'bul skabs jo ga mar sde tshan re re dang / mthar sdebs 'chams kyis gzigs 'bul zhus mthar gzim chung nas phyag srung dang / mdzod chung dang / rtse phyag sku so nas legs dar stsal sna la sku da cing / de nas lung bstan dang / rtags mtshan gyi yi ge lha sa'i kurma shar lcog gi rtsig ldebs su sbyar ba yul mis blta ba dang / ngo bshus len pa red/ chos skyong 'di'i mtshan dngos lha bya khri spyan gcig ces 'bod cing / 'on kyang rkarma shar chos skyong zhes 'bod don ni/ lha sar chos skyong bya khri spyan gcig gi lcog yod sa'i sa khul 'dir /mi shar chen zhes zer bar brten sa ming lcog tu thogs te /rma shar zhes 'bod srol 'dug

63lha sa zho ston/——༄༄/ /bod zla 7 tshes na nas bzung nyin bzhi'i ring 'o ston dngos gzhir nor gling bskal bzang pho brang bi lcags ri nang ma'i shar sngangapu gzigs zhib gzim chung khams gsum zil garnon du 7rsha nga sa 7skyabs mgon chen po zhabs sor 'khod thog de'i gzigs mthongs gdengs cha chen mo'i dbu g.yab 'og rtse gzim 'gag dang / g.yon du srid blon gyi dbu gur dang / g.yas su rgya gar gzhung tshab kyi marsha na gur zhal shar phyogs la gzigs/ byang nges yab gzhis sku ngo rnam pa dang / de'i gsham zur bcad bka' blon las zur sogs zhi drag thong stor las dkyus drung gtogs yan zhal sgo gzigs/ lto ngos rtse skor sku ngo dang / dza dar ta gsum nang ma ma/khan sde che chung snu gas zhi drag las dkyus drung galta gas/'brug 'o/ phyag kha bal 'bo/ pa lha/gas la gur khag gsum zhal byang gzigs nang so so'i go thob kyi bzhugs gdan sogs rtse gar gdan nas sngon sgron gra sgrig thog mgron gzim nas srid blon dang / gle shan rtse mgron nas yab gzhis sku sngo rnam pa gdan zhus bka' lho na sku/gas na bza' rgyun chas kha

64gsar bzhes rbe nor gling gdengs cha'i steng gral bsnar gyis phebs te so so'i go bab phyag 'bul zhus te gral la 'khod/ bod ljongs srung dmag spyi khyab dang mda' dpon sogs drag po'i 'argo byed rnams nas gus btud zhus/ srung skyob 'go dmag rnams nas ru bsgrigs zhus/ gdengs cha'i steng nas dmag spyis bod lugs dmag brda dang bstun 7rgyal glu'i rol cha dang bcas gus btud zhus te 'o/ brang lcags ri'i phyi sngagal du gnas skabs kyi sgar sar log lha zhol mi mang dang / phu gu sogs mi mang shin tu mang po sku brang la zhabs stor dang 'brel zhal mjal dang / ldad mo/ gling gtong sogs chabs cig tu yong ste ja dam nang ja dang / ku rtse'i nang zhim zas kha lag sna tshogs 'khyer yong nas spro seng btang yong / pho brang gi lcags ri'i phyi rol mal le gcig gi nang 'khor la chang rag 'thung tshong mi chog de min ja dang / zhal tog bye ril/ shing 'bras sogs stong mi mang po yong / de ltar nyin dang por lha mo ba rgyal mkhang chos rdzong ba dang /nyin gnyis par shangs ri rbha che/ nyin gsum par gcung ri bo che/ nyin bzhi par lha ra snu lung pa we/gas nas rgyal rabs mi 'dra ba'i gzhung re pa/khrab ston zhu ba de tshor nyin re bzhin 7gong sa mchog gi phyag srung dang / gzhang gnas nas legs dar dang / gnang sbyin rgya chen po stsal yong / lde'i dbar 'bras se gnyis kyi dge 'dun la nyin gsum ring rig gra zhes gaho nga sgo'i bsnyen bkur dang bzhes zas 'bul srol yong / bod zla 7 tshes 748 la ho/la gnyer las khungs nas sngar lam swā/sa gar lha tsho'i rgyal rabs nyin 'aXdangs gnyis bzhes lha/la dang / ༷ gas mtshungs tshes na nas

66'bras spungs klu 'bum/— zhe༄tsho/ /bod zla 7 tshes 8 nyin chos sde chen po 'bras spungs su/'bras spungs klu 'bum zhes grags pa 'bras cho gas chen 'du khang sbug tu klu 'bum mchod rten yod sa'i spyan sngar 'bras bla ma rig gra gtong res nas snga ra lam mchodad sprin zab rgyas khyod 'bul cadag rgyal ba'i bstan srung gnas chung chos rgyal chen wa 3na gzhir spyan 'dren dang 'brel chodas rgyal chen sgyu sa rjen mchog spyi dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i skyabarnyan la pad 'bul mgul 'cham dang 'brel ba'i snyan shal 'bul gnang dang / 'du khang nang bla spyi dang / sgo 'phyor nang bla ma rig gra dang / las byed bcas par mjal kha gnang / rig gra nas lha g.yag chodal sngo nyams brjid ldan pa zhig spyan gzigs su phul bar gzigasazhib kyis phyag nas 'alnga ra gnang mdzad/ de nyin klu 'bum dus chen la 10nga 'bras spangs dgon pa'i nang gi lha khang sku ngas rdzogs sgo dbye mdzad par brten lha khrol khul dang / nye skor gzhis khag gi grong gseb pa sku gas ser skya mi mang ji snyed rgyan gos gzab masna ra gang legs spras rbe macodad me snyan shal 'khyer nas macesad mjal la sku nga gi red/

6yer pa tshes bcu/——golko//de ni lha sa'i shar phyogs mal le sum cu tsam gyi sar ri steng brag yer pa zhes ༄/na codas rgyal sku/nga btsan gyis zhabs bcags shing /de rjes gu ru rin po che dang /jo bo rje sogs kyi sgrub gnas/sngar lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs skabs sa phud sna phud kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang yod sa'i dgon gnas der bod zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu nyin tshes bcu'i mchod sprin dang /cho gas 'khor/seng 'chams sogs 'chams sne 'ga' shas kyi ltad mo yod par lha sa ba sogs rang mos yod pa rnams mchod 'bul dang sbrags ltad mor 'gro bar byed//

lha sa'i 'ong skor/——༄tsho//de rjes lha sa nye 'khor sogs bod kyi zhing pa rnams kyis 'ong skor zhes pa gtong srol yod/de ni bod zla bdun pa'i yar ngo'i tshes grangs bzang ba zhig la zhing kha'i nye 'gram sa lha/nga zhig la gur mang sngo/ rgyab/gdan lcog dang /bza' btung gi ston mo/ rgya che gra sgrig byas/zhing pa pho mo rnams snga ༄ ༄ rengs khrus dang /rgyan gos gzab 'phyor gyis brgyan/zhing bdag rnams gyon pa gos tshos man ser po'am snyug ljang gser ma sogs kyi phyu chen la shag gyon/zhwa 'bog ser po dang /sog zhwa dmar po/'ja' lham bcas gyonate rta chas spus dag kha gsar rgyab pa'i rta zhon/thog mar lag 3dad pa'am/ser srung sngags pa nas sngags chas kha gsar spras te rta thog srid pa 'khor 'o ༄nin shing lo ma can la sgrogs pa kha btags dkar po ring po btags pa lag tu 'khyer/de rjes dpa' bo dpa' mo zhes pha ma gnyis 'jo mas kyi bu gcig dang /bu snu/ gcig rgyan be/sa kyis spras te ṭa thog lag g.yas par mda' dar re 'khyer/de rjes zhing bdag rta pa rnams phreng bstar te sngon la dal bus bskyod//de rjes skyes pho mo rnams

69rkang thang gis 7rgyal ba'i bka' bstan pod gcig re rgyab tu 'khyer nas zhing ga'am zhing kha rnams la bas ra ba rgyag dus 〉kyis 'khyer ba rnams nas cesas cirgag gi glu gzhas kyang len pa bcas nyin dgung tsam la zhing kha'am/'ong kha bskor zin pa byed/ de nas ja chang dang / ston mor longs spyad de rkang gro glu gzhas kyis gar skyid du sdod pa dang / lag stod pa'am/ sngags pa bzhugs yul dbu gur khe gtsang zhig nang bzhugs te yul lha'i ga1/la mchod mdzad/ de nas dgong dro nyi ma ma brgal tsam la phyi dro'i gsol ston grub rjes bsang bum zhig bslangs te de la me spar nas tshang mas ki babazhi lha rgyal btang ste grol nas rang khyim du log yong / gra sgrig byed po rnams de nub der bsdad de phyi nyin phyir log 'gro ba red/ de'i sang nyin lag stod pa dang / gzhis 'go'i 'thus mi drag pa gcig rtsegazim chung 'gag tu bcar te 7gong sa chen wa'i mjal kha'i snyan seng gzhes brda zhus/ de nas nyin gnyis rjes lag dod pa dang / gzhis 'go rnams dang zhing pa rnams 7song sa chen po'i mjal khar bcar/ 'od ngag rnams kyi sdus tshad kyi phud gzigs 'bul bstar sku la bcas sku da pa red//

0gzim chung chab zhugs/——ra༅༅/ /bod zlabargyad pa'i nang /dbyar zhal bzhes grub pa'i dga' ston dang /skar ma ri ṣi shar ba'i dus su chab bzhes gnang na sku gzugs la phan po yod pa skar rtsis las bshad pa bzhin chab bzhes skabs gzhung zhabs ser skya khongs/ gtogs dang bcas par gzi/ma chung chab zhugs kyi gsol ston mdo sbag khyad med nyin grangs sa/sum dang /rtse skor smu zhin grangs bdun bcas mi ra nyin ltar gsol tshigs bzhes spro sogs rgyas par phebs/nyin mtha' mar pho brang gi gzigs mthongs su bsang bum chen po bslangs te 7gong sa chen po mchog dang /rtse stor rtse mgron yan lhan bcar bcas nas ki bso'i lha rgyal gtong gnang mdzad yong /de bzhin bka' shag dang /yig tshang spro chen/rtse shod phyag mdzod/lha zhol gnyer mi da14na 14gas las khungs khag gi 1— son/dgon sde so so'i chab zhugs/bzo zhing /skyid sdug khag gi dbyar skyid sogs nyin 4 nga po gtong srol/las khungs khag gi 1/ chen la 'brelaskudadagazhung zhabs las byed gzhanadag mgron 3bod gnang yong //

72chibs bsgyur yar phebs dang / chodags phebs/— dhe༄༅༅/ /bod zla bcu pa'i zla mgo'i nang dgun thog dga' ldan lnga mchod skong 7gong sa chen po nor gling pho brang nas rtsepho brang du chibs bsgyur bkrin che rgyu'i mdzad lam chibs bsgyur mar phebs kyi lam dang 'dra ba lo ltar bstar chags dang / skabs re blon lam chen mor gzhung gnas sam/ rgyal sprul ho thog thu che khag dad sbyin gtong phod can 'byor ldan khag sogs nas 7bo nga sa 7skyabs mabo na chen cad mārgags mabo/na du gdan zhus chibs bsgyar bkrin che skabs gong gsal mdzad sgo las gzab cing rgyas spros che ba rgonang srol bzhin cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar ngo'i gza' tshes 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ rtsepho brang gi gsum skas 'og nas sbyin bdag su yin gyis mjal phyag phul te re/sa sne zhus/ gzhung ༄/ phun cho gas 'du lam brgyud 7bo/nga sa macodag phebs byams chen mo/ dang / chibs zhabs rnams ldo ring nang ma nas chibs rags thog zhol lcags ri'i gzhung sgo nas rtse pho brang la g.yas bsgor gyi lcang gseb shar brgyud phebs shing / de mtshams nas 'bras snu gas chen zhal 1ri las bya dge thab dang bcas pas phebs lam dbye ba dang / mi mang zhal mjal zhu mi ni phebs lam gyi g.yas gasku/na

73rab tu khengs nas yod cing / lha ldan gsar byung zam pa'i mtshams su gnas chung sku phebs nas gus btud sgron dar sen gsum btegs/de nas skyid ras bar nas/ yar skya rengs bar stor lto rgyud shing ra'i phyi rol du chibs zhabs rnams rta bshol/ rdo skas mtshams nas 7gong sa chen po yebs byams las bshol bar mdzad de bla steng gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod skabs phebs ston gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / dkar spro sogs gong bzhin gzab rgyas/ jo tho'i dbu skra'i mtshams shing rtsed dang /sngon pa gzhas mang sku/gas kyis glu gar gzigs 'bul/ bla phyag nas legs dar g.yogs/ yar ngo'i tshes cha bzang ba zhig la bla steng sna mas chen e waṃ du mdzad sgo dang dkar spro rgyas pa dgung gsar nyin gnyis pa lta bu la lha klu dri za grul bum gyi gar mchod med pa tsam las de byings ji lta ba bskyangs te chodags phebs kyi sbyin bdag nas legs 'bul bstar/ gsar mjal khag dang rtse swā da zhabs gsar ba 'phar ma nas gsar mjal rten gsum btegs 'bul sogs sngar ltar yong / mthar sna gas langs pa mkhan kā/ dge bshes su yin gyis tshig bkra bcad nas macadan ches ka khrir mjal dar sgrogs te mdzad sgo grol/ de mjug lhun lam ma grol gong tshogs phebs dngos gzhi'i mdzad sgo grub rjes mar ngo'i tshes cha gang 'os zhig la rtse pho brang du rgyas spros sngar bzhin phyir phebs gnang srol yong /

7 4dpal lha'i ri gra (ri rab ) /ge zher༅༅/ bod zla bcu pa'i nang lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khangagi gnas sung ga4 geg dpal lha zhi drag la rme ru tshogs yongs dang / dpal gsol ma zhes bud med lha lcam gyi chas gyon pa 'i 'don bzang ma bcas nas lo re'i 'char can lo mchod gzab gsol dang 'brel tshogs 'khor 'bul ba'idus mchod chen mor dpal lha'i ri gra (ri rab )zhes yongs su grags pa ltar/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin snga char de sngon gung thang bla ma zhang gis gter bzhes dpal lha drag mo'i zhal 'bag gasku/la ba'i sku gasku/ba gtsug lag khang gi yang steng khyams 'og gdan drangs rbe tho rengs snga char khrus gsol dang 'brel ba'i dbo/na gnyer nas zhal bsil zhus te celaphyag nas zhal gser 'bul mi 6phyag nang bgres pa gcig dang / gtan 'jags zur 'phyong lha bris pa bcas nas sgron 'bul zhus/ rtse 'phral bde phyag mdzod dang /bla phyag sku 1/ nas thugs smon snyan shal sna lnga sgron 'bul zhus 10ga gser zhib sogs rin chen sna lnga zhib zhib dngos su yod pa'i gser skyems 'bul lam zhus/ bka' shag ldan tshugs gnang ma thag tu bka' 11na lhan rgyas 'phrin bcol la phebs/ de mjug gzhung zhabs ser skya ngo ma rnams dang /
